title: School portal & term subscriptions
summary: Live school management and results portal with recurring term-based subscriptions — proof that schools will pay for reliable digital ops.
challenge: The school needed a dependable online presence for academics and results, plus a clear commercial model for ongoing support instead of one-off freelance fixes.
solution: Deployed a school portal stack (management + Educare results) with Hyperion hosting and term subscription billing. Staff were trained to publish results and manage student records without chasing developers for every term.
results: Production school portal in active use
Recurring term subscription revenue model validated
Foundation for EduSuite SaaS case study and referrals

title: Results portal for an Islamic school
summary: Student results and school web presence tailored for an Islamic school — a repeatable pattern for madrasas and faith-based institutions across Nigeria.
challenge: Parents and admin needed trustworthy online results delivery and a professional school site without complex enterprise software.
solution: Built and supported a WordPress + Educare results experience with role-aware access and PDF/email workflows suited to school term calendars.
results: Reusable delivery pattern for Islamic, private, and public schools
Named portfolio asset for EduSuite GTM

title: SME commerce & ops digital kit
summary: Modern marketing site, Paystack checkout, HR/jobs, and staff dashboards for a bottled-water brand — the template for our Commerce and Ops SKUs.
challenge: An FMCG water company needed more than a brochure site: online orders, content management, and internal portals without a large IT team.
solution: Delivered a Next.js + Payload CMS platform with Paystack payments, order flows, careers, and admin dashboards — packaged as the reference SME Digital Business Kit.
results: End-to-end SME digital stack (marketing + commerce + HR)
Repeatable quote template for Presence / Commerce / Ops SKUs
